classification: Human; Demon Slayer; Hashira; Serpent Hashira
summary: Obanai Iguro is the Serpent Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps. He is an exceptionally skilled swordsman who fights using Serpent Breathing and a uniquely curved Nichirin sword. Obanai possesses extraordinary agility, precision, perception, and swordsmanship, and his combat ability allowed him to fight alongside the other Hashira against Muzan Kibutsuji.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

notes: Post-Hashira Training Obanai without the Demon Slayer Mark. His swordsmanship is enhanced by Kaburamaru, who can guide his attacks and compensate for impaired vision. Obanai possesses the Transparent World, allowing him to perceive muscles, blood flow, and movements in greater detail and predict an opponent's actions.
